page.overview:
Who is Darius?

Darius is the husband of Shaun Gilmore. He helps Shaun with his work in Marquet. Darius has not appeared in Critical Role or Exandria Unlimited thus far.

Darius is a handsome elf with light skin and shoulder length blond hair. He is shy in public, "a perfect counterbalance" against his husband's outgoing personality, and it is rare to see him at Gilmore's Glorious Goods. Darius's singing voice and lyre playing are said to move any listener to tears.

Darius and Shaun are married and he helps him with his affairs in Marquet. Shaun refers to Darius as "lovely" when speaking about him to Fearne Calloway.
